newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer H1 orders up 11 percent.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer H1 orders up 11 percent.

text.p: Swiss technology group Sulzer AG said its consolidated orders for the first six months of 1997 rose by 322 million Swiss francs, or 11 percent, to 3.22 billion.
Orders in the comparable 1996 period totalled 2.90 billion.
Adjusted for currency fluctuation and divestitures, orders were six percent higher.
Sulzer said order intake at its Sulzer Roteq pumps and compressors group were up 19 percent to 802 million Swiss francs, orders at its Sulzer Winterthur Group were one percent higher at 523 million.
After a sharp decline last year, Sulzer Rueti's orders were 23 percent higher at 412 million francs, Sulzer said.
However, despite the encouraging growth, a positive trend in the weaving machinery business was not yet certain, Sulzer said.
Sulzer Infra Group, the company's plant and building services segment, had a four percent increase in orders to 711 million francs.

The company also said, as previously announced, Sulzer Medica Group, which had an initial public offering at the start of the week, had an order increase of 22 percent, or six percent after exchange and acquisition effects. -- Zurich Editorial +41 631 7340
